title: Learning, memory and movement in pathological and aged fly brains: credibility-screened interventions on the healthy connectome model
plan: Plan v2: Phase 2 (systematic review, credibility rubric C1-C6, shortlist; gate G2) and Phase 3 (capacity experiments on the retained cases only)
literature: literature/ (Phase 2a systematic review, maintained by the review itself)
draft_notes: No capacity experiment runs before gate G2: the atlas, the credibility scores, the calibration and the shortlist are hash-frozen in this protocol first.
Conditions are the G2 shortlist only, each with its literature-calibrated intervention; rescues only where flies show them.
Declare the Holm primary family of each retained case, and the exploratory BH families, in code/testplan.py before any of their tests is computed.
Record input hashes with Study.protocol(sources=...), fill schedule.json and tasks/, lock the tasks (Study.lock_tasks), then register (Study.register).
